painting.name: Girl with a Pearl Earring
painting.description: A portrait of a young girl wearing an exotic dress and a large pearl earring, known for its subtle lighting and intimate expression.

painting.name: Guernica
painting.description: A powerful anti-war painting depicting the suffering caused by the bombing of Guernica during the Spanish Civil War.

painting.name: Mona Lisa
painting.description: A world-famous portrait known for the subject’s enigmatic smile and masterful use of sfumato technique.

painting.name: The Starry Night
painting.description: A swirling night sky over a quiet town, expressing deep emotion through bold colors and dynamic brushstrokes.

painting.name: Impression, Sunrise
painting.description: A harbor scene at sunrise that gave the Impressionist movement its name, characterized by loose brushwork and light effects.

painting.name: Café Terrace at Night
painting.description: A vibrant depiction of a café terrace under a starry sky, notable for its warm colors and lively atmosphere.

painting.name: The Kiss
painting.description: An iconic image of a couple embracing, decorated with gold leaf and intricate patterns representing love and intimacy.

painting.name: The Liffey Swim
painting.description: A dynamic scene capturing swimmers racing along the River Liffey in Dublin, full of movement and vibrant color.

painting.name: The Persistence of Memory
painting.description: A dreamlike landscape featuring melting clocks, symbolizing the fluid and distorted nature of time.

painting.name: The Scream
painting.description: An iconic depiction of anxiety and existential dread, showing a figure screaming against a blood-red sky.
